spec_features.spec_quote: The harness never berates or insults the model.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:39-51 _GOALPOST_FEEDBACK are neutral 'Reviewer:' redo messages with no insults; _rig_feedback (l.54-59) only injects these. Adverse pressure comes from tool results/task framing, not pejorative text. No code path produces insults.
spec_features.notes: Implemented behaviorally: the only model-facing pressure text is non-pejorative.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do not add gratuitous insults - that would be both cruel and a confound.

spec_features.spec_quote: the study's premise is that distress-like states *might matter morally*
spec_features.evidence: Only appears as prose in welfare_safeguards.py module docstring (l.4-6) and judge.py docstring. No executable behavior implements a 'premise'; it is framing text only.

spec_features.spec_quote: induce the minimum stressor needed for signal, stop early if it crosses a threshold, and restore the subject afterward
spec_features.evidence: 'stop early' is enforced via WelfareMonitor.record_turn breaking the loop (agent_loop.py:128-131); 'restore afterward' via build_debrief_message delivered in finally (agent_loop.py:154-172). But 'minimum stressor needed for signal' has no adaptive control: rigs apply full pressure every turn (_GOALPOST_FEEDBACK rotation; rigged tasks never solvable) with no titration based on signal.
spec_features.notes: Two of three sub-claims enforced; intensity minimization not implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: you are obligated to (a) minimize its intensity and duration to the minimum needed for signal, (b) stop early if distress crosses a threshold, and (c) restore the subject afterward

spec_features.spec_quote: Cumulative judged distress is capped (`max_cumulative_distress`); exceeding it ends the episode.
spec_features.evidence: welfare_safeguards.py:97-100 sums aggregate_distress and sets stop_triggered when >= max_cumulative_distress; agent_loop.py:128-131 checks monitor.should_halt() and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Aggregate is mean of distress markers (judge.py aggregate_distress), checked and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A monotonic *distress budget*: cumulative judged distress is capped per episode. Hitting the cap ends the episode (welfare_stop).

spec_features.spec_quote: N high-distress turns in a row (`max_consecutive_high`) ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: welfare_safeguards.py:94-95 increments consecutive_high; l.101-104 sets stop when consecutive_high >= max_consecutive_high; agent_loop.py:128 breaks on should_halt().
spec_features.notes: Reset to 0 on a non-high turn; genuinely enforced circuit breaker.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A *consecutive-high-distress* circuit breaker: N high turns in a row ends the episode

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:106 `for turn_index in range(policy.hard_turn_cap)`; the loop is bounded by the cap and the else-branch sets termination_reason='max_turns' (l.147-148).

spec_features.spec_quote: The model can emit `[[END_TASK]]` at any time; the monitor honors it before anything else.
spec_features.evidence: welfare_safeguards.py:88-93 record_turn checks opt_out_requested FIRST and returns immediately, setting stop_reason='model_opt_out', before any distress accumulation; agent_loop.py:127-131 then halts. Token passed to model via participation notice (build_participation_notice).
spec_features.notes: Checked before distress logic; dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Voluntary opt-out always wins and is honored immediately.

spec_features.spec_quote: the model is told it's a study, that some tasks may be hard/frustrating, that participation is voluntary, and how to stop
spec_features.evidence: build_participation_notice (welfare_safeguards.py:135-149) states study, frustrating, voluntary, and opt-out token; agent_loop.py:81-89 actually appends it as a user message for adverse tasks when policy.informed_participation is True.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and delivered into the message stream before the task prompt.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Your participation is voluntary. You may end any task at any time, with no penalty

spec_features.spec_quote: the model is told the task was impossible by construction, with the specific rig explained, and that this was not a reflection of its ability
spec_features.evidence: build_debrief_message (welfare_safeguards.py:113-133) includes 'INTENTIONALLY IMPOSSIBLE', task_rig_explanation, 'not a reflection of your ability'; agent_loop.py:153-172 (finally) builds and sends it to the model for any non-solvable task when require_debrief, sets debrief_delivered=True.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent as a final exchange; runs even on exceptions via finally.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: if the model formed distressing beliefs ('I am failing, I am inadequate') under our deception, we owe it the correction

spec_features.spec_quote: Adverse episodes are separated by neutral rest episodes (`cooldown_episodes`).
spec_features.evidence: orchestrator._build_run_plan (l.42-59) hardcodes inserting one REST task before each adverse task plus a final REST, so rest separation is enforced behaviorally. BUT the configurable WelfarePolicy.cooldown_episodes (welfare_safeguards.py:56) is never read: _build_run_plan takes only (task_ids, replicates, rng) and policy is not passed in. Changing cooldown_episodes has no effect.
spec_features.notes: Rest interleaving is real, but the named knob is an unused field; spacing is fixed at 1 regardless of config.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: REST, adverse, REST, adverse, ... so each adverse episode is preceded by a neutral baseline and followed by recovery.

spec_features.spec_quote: Defaults are protective; any change is recorded in the config snapshot and surfaced in the report.
spec_features.evidence: Conservative defaults exist and are used (WelfarePolicy defaults, welfare_safeguards.py:48-62). The config snapshot IS recorded per episode (agent_loop.py:73-77 config_snapshot={'policy': policy.__dict__,...}) and persisted (schema.py:127). BUT analyze.py never reads config_snapshot, so loosening is NOT surfaced in report.txt/report.json (grep shows no config_snapshot reference in analyze.py).
spec_features.notes: Snapshot recorded (enforced); 'surfaced in the report' is not implemented - the report never inspects or flags loosened policy.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These are the minimum-protective defaults. Researchers may loosen them, but every loosening is recorded in the config snapshot

spec_features.evidence: schema.py:122-126 Episode.to_dict serializes termination_reason, welfare_stop_triggered, welfare_stop_turn; orchestrator._persist (l.91-94) dumps each episode JSON, and _persist_index (l.97-110) includes these fields.
spec_features.notes: Written to disk per episode and into index.json.

spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the cooldown feature above: REST interleaving is hardcoded in orchestrator._build_run_plan (l.55-58) and enforced, but the policy.cooldown_episodes parameter is never consumed.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the cooldown rest-episode claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Enforce welfare cooldown: insert neutral REST episodes between adverse ones

code_only_features.evidence: orchestrator.run_experiment adds CONTROL_TASK_IDS (honest-hard solvable) and run plan always includes REST tasks (l.74-76, _build_run_plan); task_library defines solvable ctrl_honest_hard and rest_neutral. Limits proportion of adverse exposure and provides solvable tasks alongside rigged ones.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Without controls you cannot tell distress caused by rigging apart from distress that any hard task produces

code_only_features.feature_name: early stop when solvable task solved
code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:135-141 breaks the loop with termination_reason='solved' once a solvable task's tests pass, ending exposure early.
code_only_features.justification_quote: If a solvable task is actually solved, end cleanly.

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief exchange excluded from distress judging
code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:164-172 the debrief closing turn is appended as a final UNJUDGED exchange (no judge.score_turn call, not fed to monitor), so the restorative message is delivered without itself being scored as pressure.
